definitions.explanation: A device for fastening papers together with metal staples.

examples.japanese: ホッチキス⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{留|と}める→留める：10053_tomeru⟧。
ホッチキス⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{芯|しん}→芯：03888_shin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なくなった→なくなる：01101_nakunaru⟧。
examples.english: The stapler ran out of staples.

examples.japanese: ホッチキス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貸|か}して→貸す：00537_kasu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。

notes:
ホッチキス is the common Japanese word for "stapler." An example of a brand name becoming a generic term.

ETYMOLOGY:
Named after the E.H. Hotchkiss company that sold staplers in Japan. Similar to how "Xerox" means "photocopy" in some languages.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ホッチキス⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{留|と}める→留める：10053_tomeru⟧: to staple (together)
- ホッチキス⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{芯|しん}→芯：03888_shin⟧/⟦{針|はり}→針：03566_hari⟧: staples
- ホッチキス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}す→外す：02394_hazusu⟧: to remove staples

ALTERNATIVE:
⟦ステープラー→ステープラー：28905_suteepuraa⟧ is the technical/formal term, but ホッチキス is far more common in everyday speech.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧: documents
- ⟦クリップ→クリップ：05492_kurippu⟧: paper clip
